root_receipt_builder:
(ns build-current-receipt
  (:require [eta-mu.receipt-river.api :as api]
            [eta-mu.receipt-river.domain.receipt :as receipt]
            [eta-mu.receipt-river.shape.edn :as edn]
            [eta-mu.receipt-river.law.receipt :as law]
            ["node:fs" :as fs]))
(def input (js->clj (js/JSON.parse (fs/readFileSync (first *command-line-args*) "utf8")) :keywordize-keys true))
(def now (.toISOString (js/Date.)))
(def application-version (.-version (js/JSON.parse (fs/readFileSync "packages/eta-mu/package.json" "utf8"))))
(def payload (receipt/build-payload (:payload input) (:repository input) now :catalog))
(def event (api/build-event {:event-id (random-uuid) :recorded-at now
                              :component-manifest {:eta-mu/version application-version}
                              :command "source-owned receipt API / stabilization evidence catalog"
                              :producer {:actor/id "codex" :source/commit (or (:producer-source input) (:parent input))}
                              :subject {:repository/id (str "github.com/" (:repository input))
                                        :source/commit (:parent input)}
                              :refs (:event-refs input)} payload))
(def line (edn/format-line event))
(def validation (api/validate-line line 348))
(assert (:ok validation))
(assert (empty? (law/record-errors event)))
(fs/writeFileSync (:out input) (str line "\n"))
(println (pr-str {:valid (:ok validation) :repo (get-in event [:event/payload :repo])
                 :recorded-at now :schema (:event/schema event) :event-id (:event/id event)}))

# E0 — Reconstruct the authoritative backlog

## Context

We need to know exactly which work exists, how branches overlap, and which source is authoritative before merging anything.

Stabilization coordination only. Preserve child ownership and existing story identities.

## Scope

- E0.1: Freeze the PR census: Capture all upstream and personal PRs with immutable head SHAs, reviews, checks and base branches.
- E0.2: Identify unique implementations: Distinguish stacked branches, duplicate source, old snapshots and changes that haven't reached upstream.
- E0.3: Reconcile Rheos ownership: Connect existing PRs, UUIDs, cards, epics and dependencies without creating duplicate tasks.
- E0.4: Preserve historical work: Secure unique code, evidence, Cephalon designs and unpublished fixes.
- E0.5: Establish campaign rules: Allow only necessary repairs during stabilization, with explicit ownership and history preservation.

The slot-by-slot exit proofs and existing-task candidates are in [the portfolio](../../stabilization/portfolio.md#e0--reconstruct-the-authoritative-backlog).

## Acceptance

Every PR has an owner, intended disposition and verified dependency relationship. The census is complete, not capped by a GitHub search-result limit.

- Resolve every slot to existing canonical work or an explicit owned gap before creating execution stories.
- Bind qualification evidence to exact source revisions and preserve prior attempts.
- Registration and board status do not qualify a milestone.

## Dependencies

None; establishes the frozen cohort.

## Evidence

[Portfolio tracker](../../stabilization/tracker.md); [source-backed work graph](../../stabilization/work-graph.json).

## Definition of done

Every PR has an owner, intended disposition and verified dependency relationship. The census is complete, not capped by a GitHub search-result limit.

# E1 — Qualify the review and merge pipeline

## Context

We cannot close hundreds of PRs reliably if the review infrastructure itself remains inconsistent.

Stabilization coordination only. Preserve child ownership and existing story identities.

## Scope

- E1.1: Qualify Muse: Resolve complete-input review and evidence-directory handling.
- E1.2: Qualify Eta Mu and Proxx: Establish source-bound reviews, independent reviewer identity, complete verdicts and failure recovery.
- E1.3: Qualify fork promotions: Ensure accepted personal-fork work reaches the appropriate organization without dropping newer history.
- E1.4: Resolve outstanding findings: Test fixes, rerun current-head reviews, and settle actual review threads.
- E1.5: Add merge-drift verification: Recheck affected consumers after each shared dependency is accepted.

The slot-by-slot exit proofs and existing-task candidates are in [the portfolio](../../stabilization/portfolio.md#e1--qualify-the-review-and-merge-pipeline).

## Acceptance

We can demonstrate at least one complete fork → reviewed upstream PR → protected merge → verified consumer update, with no approval or evidence incorrectly transferred between revisions.

- Resolve every slot to existing canonical work or an explicit owned gap before creating execution stories.
- Bind qualification evidence to exact source revisions and preserve prior attempts.
- Registration and board status do not qualify a milestone.

## Dependencies

`stabilization-e0`

## Evidence

[Portfolio tracker](../../stabilization/tracker.md); [source-backed work graph](../../stabilization/work-graph.json).

## Definition of done

We can demonstrate at least one complete fork → reviewed upstream PR → protected merge → verified consumer update, with no approval or evidence incorrectly transferred between revisions.
